description: Open a support ticket with the Halfpenny Mac team, as the user. Real people answer, on the ticket and by email to the account address. Use this when something needs a person: a Mac that will not come back, a billing question, a request the other tools cannot do. Say which machine (its name), what was tried, and quote any X-Request-Id from an error. Before opening one, check list_tickets for an existing ticket on the same subject and reply there with reply_ticket instead. Needs the support scope. At most 10 new tickets an hour per account.

body.description: The message, plain text: what is wrong, which machine, what was tried

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string with no spaces, such as a UUID. If this call fails or times out and you try again, pass the same value both times and it happens once.

subject.description: One line saying what it is about

name: open_ticket
title: Open a support ticket
